Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70210.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
sup:70210.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

sup:70210.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 80.8% (sc:70210@2026Q3).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70210.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
sup:70210.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Hallo, you did your homework with the material index and our delivery score, I'll give you that. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. Getting paid in 14 days really helps us out right now, so I can come down on the price.

We now offer a price of €32.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
